newsitem.title: INDIA: India's SPIC jumps 9.0 pct on BSE.
newsitem.headline: India's SPIC jumps 9.0 pct on BSE.

text.p: Shares of Southern Petrochemical Industries Corporation (SPIC) rose 1.50 rupees, or nearly nine percent, to 18.75 on the Bombay bourse on Thursday on select investor interest, traders said.
They said some investors were bidders in the stock after newspaper reports that the company was likely to pull out of a long-delayed petrochemicals venture and would focus on its core agro-business.

"We will be focussing more on fertiliser and other agro-businesses like pesticides, seeds, tissue culture besides chemicals, bulk drugs and formulations," the Economic Times newspaper quoted A.C. Muthiah, vice-chairman of SPIC as saying.
"We already have a good capacity in these areas and it will be expanded further," he was quoted as saying.
